title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Acts 8: the scattering of the believers, Philip in Samaria, Simon and his money, and the Ethiopian in his chariot.

questions.text: Where were the believers scattered when persecution arose in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

questions.text: What did Saul do to the assembly at this time?
questions.explanation: Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragging both men and women off to prison.

answers.text: He dragged men and women off to prison
He drove them out of the temple

questions.text: What did Philip proclaim when he went down to the city of Samaria?
questions.explanation: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed the Christ to them.

questions.text: What had Simon been practicing in the city?
questions.explanation: Simon used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one.

questions.text: What did the people of Samaria say about Simon?
questions.explanation: They all listened to him, from the least to the greatest, saying that this man is that great power of God.

answers.text: That he was a prophet like Moses
That he is that great power of God
That he was sent from Jerusalem

questions.text: What did Simon offer the apostles money for?
questions.explanation: He offered them money so that whomever he laid his hands on might receive the Holy Spirit.

answers.text: For the power to give the Holy Spirit
For a place among the apostles
For a share in the gifts for the needy

questions.text: What did Peter say to Simon about his silver?
questions.explanation: Peter said his silver would perish with him, because he thought he could obtain the gift of God with money.

answers.text: That he should give it to the needy
That he should keep it for himself
That it would buy him nothing in Samaria
That it would perish with him

questions.text: What was the Ethiopian official reading in his chariot?
questions.explanation: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, reading the prophet Isaiah.

questions.text: What did the Ethiopian answer when Philip asked if he understood his reading?
questions.explanation: He said, "How can I, unless someone explains it to me?" and begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

answers.text: "How can I, unless someone explains it?"
"I am going up to Jerusalem to ask."

questions.text: Where was Philip found afterwards, and where did he preach until he arrived?
questions.explanation: Philip was found at Azotus and passed through preaching the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

answers.text: At Gaza, until he came to Jerusalem
In Samaria, until he came to Azotus
In Joppa, until he came to Lydda
At Azotus, until he came to Caesarea
